title: MATT'S CREVICE TOOLS
tickerText:
MATT STARTED HIS TRADE AS A BOILERMAKER IN 2005, FABRICATING 45-TONNE FLOAT TRAILERS AND CUSTOM TRAILERS. BY 2008 HIS TRADE WAS COMPLETE, BUT MATT KNEW HE WANTED MORE AND WENT TO NIGHT SCHOOL TO IMPROVE HIS SKILLS.
2008 PROVED TO BE A BUSY YEAR AS MATT JOINED A COMPANY THAT HE IS STILL EMPLOYED AT TODAY, WORKING ON SOME OF THE BIGGEST GOLD MINING EQUIPMENT IN THE WORLD, ALL WHILE HONING HIS FABRICATING SKILLS INTO THE MASTER OF STEEL HE IS TODAY.
SPENDING SO MUCH TIME AROUND GOLD MINING EQUIPMENT, MATT’S INTEREST IN GOLD AND GOLD EXTRACTION GREW. BY 2021, HE DECIDED TO START HIS OWN AFTER-HOURS BUSINESS. HE BEGAN WITH SMALL STRUCTURAL STEEL JOBS AND REPAIRS TO FARMING EQUIPMENT BEFORE TURNING HIS ATTENTION TO EQUIPMENT FOR HOBBY PROSPECTORS.
MATT PUT HIS KNOWLEDGE AND FABRICATING SKILLS TO WORK, MAKING TOOLS HE COULD TEST HIMSELF WHILE PROSPECTING THE VICTORIAN GOLDFIELDS.
MATT’S CREVICE TOOLS, BASKET CLASSIFIERS AND SNUFFERS ARE JUST SOME OF THE PRODUCTS HE IS NOW KNOWN FOR IN THE PROSPECTING COMMUNITY. CUSTOMERS KNOW THEY ARE GETTING SOME OF THE BEST-MADE PRODUCTS AVAILABLE WHEN THEY USE MATT’S CREVICE TOOLS.
WITH MORE PRODUCTS CURRENTLY IN R&D, THERE’S PLENTY MORE IN THE PIPELINE FOR MATT’S CREVICE TOOLS.
